details.raw_sql:
-- Notes:
-- Removed LOWER from natco_code as there is no value in caps
-- Internalemployee filter is always 'no' in whole dataset so removing additional filter

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(event_date) AS dt,
        event_date AS date,
        page_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS err_sess
    FROM silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE 1 = 1
        AND {{date}}
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(ui_page_category) = lower({{servie_line}})
        )
     -- AND lower(internalemployee) = 'no'
     -- AND natco_code = 'de'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR lower(user_device_type) = lower({{os_naame}})
        )
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{category}})
            OR category = {{category}}
            OR LOWER(category) = {{category}}
        )
        [[ AND {{natco}} ]]
        AND action = 'errorEvent'
        AND event_type = 'debug'
        AND error_type = 'warning + confirmation'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
categorized AS (
    SELECT
        dt,
        date_trunc(
            CASE 
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily'   THEN 'day'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly'  THEN 'week'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN 'month'
            END,
            dt
        ) AS period_sort,
        CASE 
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily' THEN
                format_datetime(dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    format_datetime(date_trunc('week', dt), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
                    ' -Wk',
                    CAST(week_of_year(dt) AS VARCHAR)
                )
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN
                format_datetime(date_trunc('month', dt), 'MMM-yyyy')
        END AS period,
        CASE
            WHEN page_name = 'BASKET'                   THEN 'Basket'
            WHEN page_name = 'checkout/account'         THEN 'registration_page_(optional)'
            WHEN page_name = 'checkout/personalInfo'    THEN 'personalinfo_page'
            WHEN page_name = 'checkout/personalinfo'    THEN 'personalinfo_page'
            WHEN page_name = 'checkout/identification'  THEN 'ident_page_(optional)'
            WHEN page_name = 'checkout/appointment'     THEN 'appointment_page_(optional)'
            WHEN page_name = 'checkout/payment'         THEN 'payment_page'
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%consent%'             THEN 'orderreview_page'
            WHEN page_name = 'checkout/shipping'        THEN 'Shipping'
            ELSE 'Others'
        END AS page_category,
        err_sess
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    period,
    page_category,
    SUM(err_sess) AS err_sess
FROM categorized
WHERE page_category <> 'Others'
GROUP BY period_sort, period, page_category
ORDER BY period_sort;
